cohort: Healthy active duty (AD) nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies >32 weeks, delivering at a tertiary medical center between 2011 and 2016.
finding: Pre-pregnancy physical fitness was not associated with Cesarean delivery (CD), while excessive gestational weight gain (EWG) and neonatal birth weight were independently associated with an increased CD rate.
mod_finding: Pre-pregnancy fitness levels showed no association with the incidence of labored Cesarean delivery (CD), but excessive gestational weight gain (EWG) was identified as a modifiable factor increasing CD risk.
